newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RMB BUYS STAKE IN COMMODITIES TRADING FIRM.
newsitem.headline: RMB BUYS STAKE IN COMMODITIES TRADING FIRM.

text.p: Rand Merchant Bank (RMB) said on Tuesday its equity investment vehicle RMB Ventures had acquired about 35 percent of commodities trading firm Exatrade for 45 million rand.
The group said in a statement the investment would allow for further development of its commodity trading activities.
Exatrade's core activites are bulk trading in agricultural and industrial commodities, investments in service-orientated activities and trade finance.
RMB said Exatrade was seen as one of the largest trading houses in the African sub-continent, particularly in grains, oil seeds, vegetable oils, dairy products and sugar.
In addition, the group is involved in the industrial sector in petroleum, crude oil and refined petroleum products as well as industrial chemicals.
